title: Pedestrian Crossing Intent Classification From Event-Based Vision Using Convolutional Spiking Neural Networks With Temporal Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.13328v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Anticipating whether a pedestrian will cross the road is safety-critical for autonomous vehicles, requiring real-time inference under challenging conditions including motion blur, high dynamic range, and class imbalance. Conventional frame-based deep networks process redundant RGB data at fixed frame rates, limiting their temporal resolution and energy efficiency. In this work we present an end-to-end pipeline that (i) converts real-world driving footage from the Joint Attention in Autonomous Driving (JAAD) dataset into synthetic dynamic vision sensor (DVS) event streams using the v2e simulator, (ii) augments training with the CARLA-simulated DVS sequences of the DVS-PedX dataset under both normal and adverse weather conditions, and (iii) trains a novel convolutional spiking neural network (Conv-SNN) with clip-consistent DVS augmentation to classify pedestrian crossing intent as binary: crossing or non-crossing. translated_title: 基于事件视觉的行人过街意图分类：使用时间增强的卷积脉冲神经网络
translated_abstract: 预测行人是否将横穿马路对自动驾驶车辆而言是安全攸关的任务，需要在运动模糊、高动态范围和类别不平衡等具有挑战性的条件下进行实时推理。传统的基于帧的深度网络以固定帧率处理冗余的RGB数据，限制了其时间分辨率和能效。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个端到端的流程：(i) 使用v2e模拟器将自动驾驶联合注意（JAAD）数据集中的真实驾驶视频转换为合成的动态视觉传感器（DVS）事件流，(ii) 利用DVS-PedX数据集在正常和恶劣天气条件下的CARLA模拟DVS序列来增强训练，以及 (iii) 训练一种新颖的卷积脉冲神经网络（Conv-SNN），采用与片段一致的DVS数据增强，将行人过街意图分类为二分类问题：过街或不过街。我们详细介绍了所有架构……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合时间数据增强的卷积脉冲神经网络，利用事件相机数据进行行人过街意图的实时二分类，为自动驾驶车辆提供高时间分辨率且节能的行人意图预测方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel convolutional spiking neural network with clip-consistent DVS temporal augmentation to classify pedestrian crossing intent from event-based vision data, enabling real-time, energy-efficient prediction for autonomous driving safety.
